title: Modern Library Packaging: ESM/CJS, TypeScript & `package.json` Exports
subtopicTitle: Modern Library Packaging: ESM/CJS, TypeScript & `package.json` Exports
problemStatement:
Compiling component libraries with tsup/Rollup, dual ESM/CJS distribution, sideEffects: false, and strict exports maps.

**Enterprise Importance**:
Poor library packaging can balloon consumer bundle sizes by megabytes and break SSR in Next.js or Vite.
interviewTrap: Exporting all components from a single index.js with side-effects, forcing bundlers to bundle the entire library even if only one button was imported.

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: Use package.json `exports` to define sub-path imports (`import { Button } from '@ds/react/button'`). Mark `"sideEffects": false` so bundlers can tree-shake unused components.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Design Token Layer: Primitives, semantic aliases, and component tokens established.
2. Component Architecture: Headless state and keyboard accessibility hooks implemented.
3. Styling & Cascade: Zero-runtime CSS variables and layer specificity managed.
4. Governance & Packaging: Tree-shaking, semantic versioning, and telemetry monitored.
